description.en: An amber-preserved fungal cup has a scale-edged rim and a visible internal peridiole.
description.zh: 琥珀保存菌杯具有鳞片状杯缘及可见的内部包被小体。

scientific_scope.en: Fossil-specimen concept for Nidula baltica, limited to the preserved organ or thallus described here; no complete parent organism is implied.
scientific_scope.zh: Nidula baltica 的化石标本概念，仅限本文所述保存器官或叶状体，不暗示已知完整母体。

distinctness.en: An open nest-shaped cup and internal lenticular body differ from a gilled cap or continuous pore sheet.
distinctness.zh: 开放巢形杯及内部透镜状小体区别于菌褶盖或连续孔层。

modeling_brief.en: Use the corrected holotype views for the cup, overlapping rim scales and visible peridiole; any transparent display base is an artistic choice.
modeling_brief.zh: 依据更正后的正模视图制作杯体、重叠杯缘鳞片及可见包被小体；透明展示底座仅为美术选择。

uncertainty: Eocene Baltic amber specimen; original tissue colour and hidden exterior details remain unknown.
reference_notes: Planning record only. Source access labels distinguish opened pages from indexed abstracts/excerpts. Reference-ready is not a released model or a completed dimensional/rights audit. The 2021/2022 corrigendum validates the name omitted from MycoBank in 2014 and fixes mislabeled captions. Use corrected figures 1–2 for Baltic holotype AF-9-20B; figure 3 is Cyathus, not this asset.

sources.title: Bird's nest fungi in Baltic and Dominican amber
sources.supports: Eocene Nidula baltica cup and internal peridioles.

sources.title: Corrigendum to ‘Bird's nest fungi (Nidulariales: Nidulariaceae) in Baltic and Dominican amber’ [Fungal Biol. 118/3 (2014) 325–329]
sources.supports: Validates Nidula baltica with MycoBank 841405; corrected figures 1–2 identify the Baltic amber holotype and its cup/peridiole.
